title: All endpoints mounted under /api, deviating from spec paths
evidence: src/server.ts:13 `app.use('/api', bookRouter)` — spec (TASK.md) and REQUIREMENTS.json ask for bare `POST /books`, `GET /health` etc., but the service serves `/api/books`, `/api/health`.
suggestion: Mount the router at `/` (or add an unprefixed alias) so endpoints match the spec paths.

title: README documents /books and /health but implementation serves /api/*
evidence: README.md:6-12 lists `POST /books`, `GET /health` with no /api prefix, while src/server.ts:13 mounts the router at /api — following the README literally yields 404s.
suggestion: Update README endpoint docs to the actual /api/* paths, or drop the /api prefix in server.ts to match.

title: Year range validation added beyond spec
evidence: src/middleware/validation.ts:15-20 rejects year outside 0-9999 (400 'Invalid year'); TASK.md only required title/author validation.
suggestion: None — reasonable enhancement, covered by tests (validation.test.ts:65-82).
